slides.title: The inspector asked for everyone's CPR cards
slides.body: They were all in the binder. Two of them had expired months ago.

slides.title: A binder stores cards, not deadlines
slides.body: Staff certifications expire on different dates. Nobody flips through a binder until someone asks.

slides.title: Track every staff cert in one place
slides.body: CPR, licenses, credentials, insurance: one list with dates and a reminder well before each one expires.

slides.title: Stop trusting the binder
slides.body: CertTrack tracks every license, cert and policy and alerts you before anything expires.
